SHINDOの起ち上げメンバー、活動基盤となる自然農法無の会、現場を支える技術者: Meet SHINDO's founding members, Munokai Natural Farm as our base, the craftspeople who support the field, partners from across Japan, and the villagers who work alongside us in Showa Village.
ORGANIZERS ── 運営している人たち: ORGANIZERS ── The people who run it
福島県会津・奥会津で、自然農法から暮らしの土台をつくる「SHINDO」の運営法人: The company that runs SHINDO, which builds the foundations of life from natural farming in Aizu and Oku-Aizu, Fukushima. We bring people active in fields other than farming from across Japan to Aizu, and through dialogue on the ground, turn ideas into projects one by one. By putting people, resources, and money to good use, we create a place for co-creation where both our companions and the region grow richer.
学者を志したのち、より本質に近い生業を求めて自然農法の道へ。全国30件以上の農家: After aspiring to be a scholar, he turned to natural farming in search of a livelihood closer to the essentials. He visited more than 30 farms across Japan before moving to Aizu in 2021. The founder of SHINDO.
SHINDOは、株式会社ZEN-BUが運営するプロジェクトです。パートナーとの共: SHINDO is a project run by ZEN-BU Inc. Co-creation partner agreements with partners and service contracts with field members are both concluded with ZEN-BU, and the financial statements for the project are published under ZEN-BU's name.
現場を、技術で支える人たち。: The people whose skills support the field.
豪雪の中山間地で暮らしと事業を成り立たせているのは、地元の技術です。: In these snowy highlands, it is local skill that makes both life and business possible.

会津の伝統工法と自然乾燥の木材で、住む人を健康にする家を建てる工務店。理空の設計: A builder that uses Aizu's traditional construction methods and naturally dried timber to create houses that keep their residents healthy. Shiki designed and built Rikū. The site is led by a rare team of craftsmen, including master carpenter Masakuni Hoshi, who has built more than 700 houses since his mid-teens.
農業機械の開発から中古農機の入手・修理・施工まで。: From developing farm machinery to sourcing, repairing, and installing used equipment.
昭和村・小野川の共同宿場を整備してくださっている、金山町の若手大工さんたち。: The young carpenters from Kaneyama who are building the shared lodge in Onogawa, Showa Village.
荒れた耕作放棄地を整備してもらい、自然農法の経験や知恵を学ばせてもらっています。: They help us clear overgrown, abandoned farmland, and share their experience and wisdom in natural farming.
全国各地、それぞれの持ち場から。: From all over Japan, each from their own place.
全国から35組を超えるパートナーが関わっています。: More than 35 partners from across Japan are involved.

創業21年。福島県内で最大規模の有機JAS農家であり、SHINDOの実践知の源で: Founded 21 years ago, the largest JAS-certified organic farm in Fukushima, and the source of SHINDO's practical knowledge. Both founders, Uno and Ōshima, started out by learning to farm here.

農業生活12年目。苗づくりの安定と面積拡大を実現。: In his twelfth year of farming. Stabilized seedling production and expanded the cultivated area.
三年前、都内の企業を辞めて会津へ。無の会のお米の栽培と農園経営を担当。: Left a company in Tokyo three years ago for Aizu. Responsible for rice cultivation and farm management at Munokai.
2025年に札幌から移住。無の会の野菜栽培を担う。: Moved from Sapporo in 2025. Runs vegetable growing at Munokai.
自動車ディーラーから転身。不耕起栽培と機械開発を担当。: Formerly at a car dealership. Responsible for no-till cultivation and machinery development.
